    What is the address of Nanjing Zhongshan International Golf Club - Mountain/Lake Course?

    Nanjing Zhongshan International Golf Club - Mountain/Lake Course is located at 9 Huanling Rd, Xuanwu, Nanjing, Jiangsu, 210042, China.

    Is Nanjing Zhongshan International Golf Club - Mountain/Lake Course open to the public?

    Yes, Nanjing Zhongshan International Golf Club - Mountain/Lake Course is open to the public.
